currentState.dataFlow: LLM Tool Call (search_activities/get_activity_template/activity) → TemplateRepository.list/get → TemplateLoader.list/load → Cache Check (5-min TTL) → TemplateServiceClient.searchTemplates/getTemplate → MetabobCLI.searchActivities/getActivity → MCP Boundary (search_activities/activity tools) → Metabob Backend → JSON Response → JSON.parse() [NO VALIDATION] → ActivitySchemaAdapter.toCanonical() → Extract Learning Metrics (execution_count→executions, success_rate→successRate, avg_duration_ms→avgDuration, avg_cost→avgCost, NO TOKEN DATA→avgTokens=zeros) → Generate version/genealogy → OpenCodeTemplate → Cache Write → Return to caller

genealogy: Created client-side with MANUAL reason, HYBRID author to track template provenance

desiredState.description: Minimal changes to restore working state while ensuring learning data flows correctly
objectives: Eliminate code duplication between ActivitySchemaAdapter and BootstrapTemplates (unify on adapter)
Preserve all learning metrics during retrieval (executions, successRate, avgDuration, avgCost)
Document intentional information loss (avgTokens, version, genealogy) vs unintentional bugs
Add validation at MCP boundary to catch malformed backend data
Maintain round-trip compatibility awareness (fromCanonical → backend → toCanonical loses metadata)

minimalChanges.change: Delegate to ActivitySchemaAdapter.toCanonical instead of reimplementing conversion logic
minimalChanges.reason: Eliminate 70% code duplication, ensure consistent behavior between MCP and bootstrap templates
minimalChanges.impact: No behavior change - both converters produce identical output, but single source of truth

minimalChanges.change: Add optional zod validation after JSON.parse() with graceful degradation (log error, return undefined)
minimalChanges.reason: Catch malformed backend data early, improve debugging
minimalChanges.impact: Better error handling - malformed data returns undefined instead of causing downstream runtime errors

minimalChanges.change: Add inline code comments documenting intentional information loss (avgTokens, version, genealogy) with rationale
minimalChanges.reason: Clarify design decisions for future maintainers, prevent 'fixes' that break assumptions

criticalInsights: INTENTIONALLY LOSSY: avgTokens hardcoded to zeros is by design (backend limitation), not a bug to fix
DEFENSIVE CODING: Field aliasing (task_id || id, template || activity, task_steps || tasks) indicates backend format instability
N+1 PERFORMANCE: 101 MCP calls for 100 templates - backend API limitation, not client bug (requires backend batch API)
ROUND-TRIP INCOMPATIBLE: fromCanonical → backend → toCanonical loses metadata (version, genealogy, avgTokens) - this is intentional
CODE DUPLICATION: ActivitySchemaAdapter (150 lines) vs BootstrapTemplates (140 lines) - ~70% overlap indicates need for unification
CACHE STALENESS: 5-minute TTL means metrics can be stale - acceptable trade-off for performance vs freshness
NO SCHEMA VALIDATION: JSON.parse() without zod validation means malformed backend data silently accepted

architecturalBoundaries.name: MCP Protocol (Network Boundary)
architecturalBoundaries.resilience: Graceful degradation - returns undefined on failure
architecturalBoundaries.risk: No API versioning - tool names hardcoded, breaking changes break silently

architecturalBoundaries.name: Schema Adapter (Data Format Boundary)
architecturalBoundaries.coupling: Tight (field-by-field mapping, breaking changes require adapter update)
architecturalBoundaries.risk: Breaking backend schema changes require client adapter update

architecturalBoundaries.name: Cache Layer (Storage Boundary)
architecturalBoundaries.resilience: TTL expiration (5 min), LRU eviction, periodic cleanup
architecturalBoundaries.risk: Cache staleness - metrics stale for up to 5 minutes, manual invalidation required

architecturalBoundaries.name: Bootstrap Templates (File System Boundary)
architecturalBoundaries.coupling: Medium (JSON schema changes break embedded templates)
architecturalBoundaries.resilience: Whitelist enforcement (BOOTSTRAP_TEMPLATES Set), fallback only for approved templates
architecturalBoundaries.risk: No migration strategy, deprecated system (should phase out)

risks.impact: Token efficiency tracking impossible for Metabob templates until first local execution. Thompson Sampling cannot use token metrics for template selection.
risks.mitigation: Backend schema extension to include avg_tokens {input, output, cache} in estimated_metrics (requires backend coordination)

risks.impact: Performance degrades linearly (101 MCP calls for 100 results). Unacceptable at scale.
risks.mitigation: Backend batch retrieval API (get_activities_batch tool) or include estimated_metrics in search_activities response

risks.impact: Malformed backend data silently accepted, causes runtime errors downstream (missing fields, wrong types)
risks.mitigation: Add zod validation after JSON.parse() with error logging and graceful degradation

risks.impact: Divergence risk, inconsistent behavior, double maintenance burden, different token handling
risks.mitigation: Extract shared conversion logic, make BootstrapTemplates delegate to ActivitySchemaAdapter

risks.impact: Stale metrics for up to 5 minutes after backend updates. Templates executed elsewhere don't reflect latest learning data.
risks.mitigation: Reduce TTL (performance hit) or implement push-based cache invalidation via MCP subscriptions

risks.impact: Backend schema changes break silently, no graceful degradation for incompatible versions
risks.mitigation: Add version header to MCP calls, implement version negotiation

risks.impact: Edit-and-reregister workflows lose metadata (version, genealogy, avgTokens). Template evolution creates NEW variants instead of updates.
risks.mitigation: Document limitation, use semantic versioning for template edits, treat as feature not bug

validationStrategy.roundTripTest: Create template → ActivitySchemaAdapter.fromCanonical → (simulated backend) → ActivitySchemaAdapter.toCanonical → compare. Expect known information loss: avgTokens (zeros), version (regenerated), genealogy (regenerated).
validationStrategy.schemaValidation: Add zod validation at MCP boundary (MetabobCLI.callMCPTool) with graceful degradation (log error, return undefined)
validationStrategy.performanceTest: Measure TemplateServiceClient.searchTemplates latency for 100 templates. Expect ~5-10 seconds with N+1 pattern (101 sequential MCP calls).
validationStrategy.learningDataIntegrity: Verify executions, successRate, avgDuration, avgCost correctly extracted from estimated_metrics and preserved through cache/load cycles

reusablePatterns.description: Check cache with TTL expiration, fetch from backend on miss, cache result
reusablePatterns.applicability: Any frequently-accessed, slowly-changing data with acceptable staleness
reusablePatterns.abstraction: CachedRepository<T> with configurable TTL and fetch function

reusablePatterns.description: Fetch summaries, then Promise.all() detail fetches for each summary
reusablePatterns.applicability: Temporary solution when backend lacks batch API (NOT recommended for production at scale)
reusablePatterns.warning: Should be migrated to batch API when available

reusablePatterns.description: Convert external schema to internal schema with null-coalescing, validation fallbacks, enum normalization
reusablePatterns.applicability: Any external API integration (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), database ORM layer, message queue consumers

reusablePatterns.description: Try primary source (cache), fallback to secondary (backend), fallback to tertiary (bootstrap), return undefined if all fail
reusablePatterns.applicability: Microservices with redundant data sources, offline-first applications, multi-region deployments
